usage.intro.description: UtauTTS is a Japanese TTS that combines UTAU voicebank concatenation with learning-based intonation adjustment.
usage.intro.placeholder: This window explains how to use each feature. Choose a topic from the menu on the left.
usage.pitch.description: The vertical lines on the pitch graph mark the start of each mora. The space to the right of a line is that mora's duration. Here, "mora duration" simply means the length of each word.
usage.step.dictionary.1: You can register reading substitutions from "Dictionary Settings..." in the "Settings" menu.
usage.step.dictionary.2: You can reload voicebanks from "Reload Voicebanks" in the "File" menu.
usage.step.dictionary.3: You can check the current voicebank from "Voicebank Details..." in the "Help" menu.
usage.step.parameters.1: Choose the voicebank to use under "Voicebank" on the right.
usage.step.parameters.2: Choose the model for automatic accent estimation under "Intonation Model".
usage.step.parameters.3: Specify the reference pitch (e.g. C4) under "Pitch Reference". (Only available for voicebanks with a prefix.map)
usage.step.parameters.4: Adjust the pacing of speech with the "Intonation", "Mora Duration", and "Pause Duration" sliders.
usage.step.parameters.5: Double-click a slider to reset it to its default value.
usage.step.pitch.1: Select a point and drag vertically to change its pitch.
usage.step.pitch.2: Dragging a vertical line horizontally moves only that line, changing the duration of the adjacent moras.
usage.step.pitch.3: Hold Shift while dragging a vertical line horizontally to move everything after that word together.
usage.step.pitch.4: Drag the last empty vertical line to adjust the duration of the final mora.
usage.step.pitch.5: Double-click a point to restore the model-generated pitch; double-click near the mora duration below a vertical line to reset the mora duration.
usage.step.playback.1: Select the utterance you want to play.
usage.step.playback.2: Choose "Play Selected Text" from the "Playback" menu, or press Ctrl+Enter to synthesize and play.
usage.step.playback.3: Use "Play All Text" to play everything at once.
usage.step.playback.4: Use "Save as WAV..." to export to a file.
usage.step.project.1: Open a saved project via "Open Project..." in the "File" menu.
usage.step.project.2: Save the current content via "Save Project...".
usage.step.project.3: Export an exo for AviUtl via "Export as exo...".
usage.step.settings.1: You can change the default mora duration, default pause duration, whether manual pitch editing is allowed, the theme (dark mode), and more from "Settings..." in the "Settings" menu.
usage.step.settings.2: You can change the keys for synthesis, saving the project, adding text, and more in the "Shortcuts" tab.
usage.step.settings.3: Changes are applied with the "Save" button.
usage.step.textInput.1: Enter the sentence you want to read in the text field at the top.
usage.step.textInput.2: Click the "Add Utterance" button or press Ctrl+D to add the utterance.
usage.step.textInput.3: Edit the text of the selected utterance and press Enter to confirm.
usage.step.utterance.1: Clicking a card selects that utterance and makes it the target of pitch editing.
usage.step.utterance.2: Use the "⋮" menu at the top right of a card to move it up, move it down, or delete it.
usage.step.utterance.3: Drag and drop a card's image to reorder it.
usage.step.utterance.4: Press Delete (or your configured shortcut) to remove the selected utterance.
